infobox.usage: Unlocks dorm room 203 in the three-story dorms on Customs.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Dorm room 203 key (Dorm 203) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the three-story dormitory with a tag reading "203" on it.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a mandatory key for Shaking Up the Teller

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text:
- Inside a red mug in dorm room 214.

- Warehouse #4 at the crane yard, on a table in the northern part of the top floor.

- Warehouse #5 at the crane yard, on the table with the lamp near a forklift.

- Warehouse #6 next to the fuel silos, on a table in the workshop in the southern part of the second floor.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The second floor of the three-story dorms on Customs.
